Texto Dallas creates the nails of the future and hairstylist Charlie Le Mindu dresses the staircase at La Samaritaine with hair.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: La grande galerie de la Francophonie
programme.desc: Actor, screenwriter, director and member of the Comédie-Française, Guillaume Gallienne has published "Le Buveur de brume", inspired by a night spent in a museum in Georgia. With him, we welcome Bruno Ély, director of the Musée Granet in Aix-en-Provence and a specialist in the painter Paul Cézanne. An artist who Guillaume Gallienne knows well, having portrayed him on the big screen. Victor Obalk tells us all about the Spanish painter Diego Velázquez. Alex Vizorek takes us to Liège, Belgium, for an exhibition devoted to the French photographer Robert Doisneau.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: Through rooms filled with colour, Stefania di Petrillo explores the emotional dimension of design. With Marion Flament the art of stained glass breaks free from its traditional constraints.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: We head off to the Fine Arts Museum in Libourne. Deep dive into sculptor Hugo Servanin's library of bodies and engineering laboratory. Danish designer Cécilie Bahnsen: combining Scandinavian pragmatism with French know-how. Discovery: digital light embroidery by Lou de Pray.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Since the company's earliest days Pierre Frey has symbolised luxury in the world of furnishing fabrics: a reputation based on its unwavering respect for traditional know-how. All about the pretzel. Martres-Tolosane is one of the France's earthenware capitals. How to wear a cardigan for guaranteed style.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S11
programme.desc: Hugo Lienhard is a model craftsman. After working on scenery for theatre and opera, today he makes impressive miniature archaeological reconstitutions for several museums in French-speaking Switzerland.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: From self-taught to Michelin-starred chef, at Le Grand Véfour Guy Martin looks back over a career in gastronomy. Amandine Antunez masters the art of marble-stucco using plant-based dyes.

programme.title: Partis rouler
programme.desc: Visit to one of the most beautiful mountain biking sites in Canada: the Bras-du-Nord valley, close to Québec. The quality of its biking trail network and its sustainable tourism model make it a must.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: Visit to the three museums at the Polish Library in Paris. Shapes navigate between imaginary worlds in ceramic artist Clémentine de Chabaneix's universe. Willy Chavarria, American-Mexican designer and activist, shows at the American Cathedral in Paris. Bookbinders and gilders, Nathalie and Christophe Legrand restore books which they cover in light.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: #VF

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Exploring the world behind the scenes of a runway show helps in understanding its inspirations: Akris cultivates a taste for detail. Where does the expression "bon appétit!" come from? An immersive visit to the Souffle fair, a celebration of arts and crafts. The bubble skirt conquers the catwalk.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S11
programme.desc: Paul Bischof is a logger in Grande Béroche. After a whole life in the woods, he knows everything there is to know about trees. Before retiring, he shares his immense knowledge with a student in forestry and his apprentices.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: With generous silhouettes and delicate transparency, designer Arthur Avellano takes latex to its limits and beyond. Stéphanie Trolez brings the art of straw marquetry to cabinet-making.

programme.title: Chine, Les maitres de l’Art
programme.desc: Che Peng Fei sublimates traditional Chinese painting by charging it with a unique poetic sensibility. His art, inspired by nature and philosophy, evokes a rich, contemplative inner world.

programme.title: Partis rouler
programme.desc: Alexis and Antoine are going to make the most of a huge playing field: the Canadian tundra in the Yukon region. Whitehorse and its surroundings are covered by a vast network with more than 700 kms of biking trails.

programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: At the Yves Saint Laurent museum: an exhibition dedicated to the great French designer's desire for transparency. Discovering the painful history behind Creole beauty and, in Revel, the art of woodworking imbued with skill and love. Baby blue, or how to explore the depths of style in all its aspects.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: La grande galerie de la Francophonie
programme.desc: He is an iconic figure in French rap. Writer, composer and musician, Oli forms a cult duo with his brother Bigflo, now enjoying international popularity. It's less well known, but the rapper is also an art lover, and he's our guest to talk about it. And among the talents that Oli had chosen to exhibit in his Musée imaginaire, at the Abattoirs in Toulouse, there was a name on the rise: Karl N'da Adopo. Originally from the Ivory Coast, the artist conceives painted works inspired by major contemporary issues. And Alex Vizorek has his eye on the brilliant Paul Cézanne in Vizorek'xpert!

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: We head to Meudon for a very personal visit to Rodin's studio. Virginie Friedmann and Delphine Versace: a love story between materials and unexpected surprises.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: Pissarro-Pontoise Art and History Museum displays the impressionist master's works. Mathieu Bassée and the team at Studio MTX are inspired by materials to embroider space. Miu Miu mixes genders and breaks codes. Sculptor and jewellery designer Chloé Valorso creates dreamlike objects inspired by animals, plants and minerals.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Founded in 1908, the company La Cornue is a reference in the world of luxury ovens and cookers. All about the history of the "marcel" vest. In Saint-Léonard-de-Noblat, exploring the manufacture and printing of paper at the Moulin du Got paper mill. Wearing tights has never been so on-trend!

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08

programme.desc: Camille is a teacher, Guido an engineer at the EPFL and Lyell a high-flying performer. All three share a passion, the slackline, balancing on a line between two mountains. They talk about their fear of heights, the mastery of their mind and body, and surpassing themselves.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: From tiny to over-sized, ceramic artist Grégoire Scalabre sculpts and accumulates objects. Christophe and Séverine Lauduique make Basque knives.

programme.title: Chine, Les maitres de l’Art
programme.desc: A master of porcelain painting, Li Jusheng perpetuates his ancestral skills with great precision. His delicate and powerful works reflect a deep respect for Chinese tradition.

programme.title: Partis rouler
programme.desc: Still in the Yukon region, in Carcross, the two friends discover the Indigenous Tagish community which created a globally-reputed network of biking trails as part of the Singletrack to Success project.

programme.desc: For the autumn/winter 2024-2025 season the Paris haute couture catwalks had plenty of surprises on offer: a look back at the latest trends along with gems from the Baqué Molinié textile studio. Menswear continues to reinvent its identity, as demonstrated by the spring-summer 2025 collections.

programme.title: La grande galerie de la Francophonie
programme.desc: Charlotte Casiraghi is an emblematic personality of Monaco, a leading figure in the world of culture and fashion, and passionate about philosophy. She is also a writer. She is our guest as she publishes "La Fêlure", a tribute to the figures in her artistic pantheon. Alongside her, a genius of the comic book world. Enki Bilal depicted the humanity of the future like no one else in his cult series?"Bug". And Nicolas Poussin, as seen by Alex Vizorek, is the subject of the Vizorek'xpert focus.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: Direction for to visit Rodin's home and studio. Ceramic artist Grégoire Scalabre sculpts and accumulates to enter another dimension, between tiny and gigantic. programme.desc: Artist cabinet-maker Kostia combines tradition and design innovation. From micro to macro-embroidery, the designer Cyrielle Leclère takes the craft beyond its traditional frame.

His shots will be exhibited at the Musée de l'Homme, in Paris, as part of the exhibition Les grands âges (from 8 April 2026 to 3 January 2027). The genius of Rembrandt through the eye of Alex Vizorek, and the work of the painter Jacques-Louis David, seen by the art historian Hector Obalk.

programme.desc: Yan Gongda embodies the excellence of contemporary Chinese calligraphy. Heir to a long line of artists, he combines technical rigour and freedom of expression in a deeply spiritual practice.

programme.title: Partis rouler
programme.desc: Exploring the other side of Newfoundland near Corner Brook. The two cyclists discover riding in the steep wilderness and a real way of sharing.

programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.desc: Philippe Hurel, manufacturing high quality furniture since 1911. "L'habit ne fait pas le moine" (the clothes don't make the man): a very French expression from... Monaco. In Milly-la-Forêt we discover the work of French artist Jean Cocteau. A timeless essential for the winter wardrobe: how to wear a cable sweater.

programme.desc: A comedian and actor, Jonathan Lambert has a passion for art, and is the author of a photo-novel, "Qui a volé mes jambes?" (Who stole my legs?), a tribute to the surrealist painter Pierre Molinier. He is also curator of the exhibition "A Hundred Years of Chess", presented at the Perrotin Gallery in Paris. Pauline Guerrier is a cosmopolitan and well-travelled artist. Her sculptures and tapestries are inspired by her encounters with craftspeople from Benin to India. Claire Tabouret's drawings at the Grand Palais and her stained-glass windows at Notre-Dame are in the Vizorek'xpert chronicle. A look back at the theft of a Rembrandt, with Reza Pounewatchy.

programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy and art de vivre... Lifestyle experts chat with Katherina Marx, an enthusiastic ambassador for French style.

At Schiaparelli, masculine and feminine are confidently combined. Dive behind the scenes of D'Offard wallpaper production.

programme.title: #VF S09
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.desc: We take a closer look during Paris fashion week at the new trends at Dior, Weinsento, Paco Rabanne, Saint Laurent, Balmain and Akris. programme.title: CHIC EN VF S10
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy and art de vivre... Lifestyle experts chat with Katherina Marx, an enthusiastic ambassador for French style.

programme.desc: Cindy, Roland, Seni and Christian share a common passion, free-diving in the lakes of Romandy. Whether in search of the mysteries of the deep, or the simple pleasure of being embraced by the water, exploring the depths also reveals their inner nature.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: Clémence d'Ennery unveils her collection of Asian works in a Paris hotel. Using porcelain petals, Juliette Clovis opens up a luminous, dreamlike world. At Rabanne, we push the boundaries of women's dressing with bold materials. Immerse yourself in the studio of artist Marion Mezenge.

programme.title: #VF S09
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.desc: Painter and creator of unique mural decors, the artist Solène Eloy is inspired by the fresco painting technique. Everything you need to know about the design of the first Air Max. In Normandy, stopover at Villedieu-les-Poêles, in the heart of L'Atelier du cuivre. The chic way to wear jogging bottoms.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S09
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy and art de vivre... Lifestyle experts chat with Katherina Marx, an enthusiastic ambassador for French style.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S12
programme.desc: Amongst the vines of Lavaux, the World Tracassets Championships is a spring carnival where anything goes. The tracassets, small three-wheeled tractors, were built in the 1950s to work the steep slopes of the vineyards. To compete in the famous race, each has been meticulously customised.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: We're off to the Musée des Beaux-Arts in Tours! In the heart of Paris, mosaic artist Luigi La Ferla builds and deconstructs his works. With Mame Kurogouchi, shape is sculpted from the body itself. Painter Camille Viry brings her landscapes to life using traditional decorative painting techniques.

programme.title: #VF S09
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.desc: The Marathon de la Mode Durable: a runway show designed to showcase the creativity of the IFA Paris students. Focus on seersucker, a fabric we know so well but without realising it. Moirans en Montagne makes high quality wooden toys. How to wear a bathrobe.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S09
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: DESTINATION FRANCOPHONIE 2025-2026
programme.desc: Welcome to very Francophile Albania, where the French language has left its mark on history. First stop, Korça, the cradle of Albanian Francophonie, home to the French military cemetery and the first French high school founded in the Balkans. Then on to Gjirokastër, the stone city, and Berat, the city of a thousand windows.

programme.desc: Mireille Keïta builds bridges between the country that offered her a home, Switzerland, and her native Africa. She is the organiser of the Yelen Africa Festival in Baulmes, showcasing the advantages of cultural mixity. The profits are then used to improve people's lives in several villages in Mali.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: In Boulogne-Billancourt, visit the Musée des Années 30. Stefania Di Petrillo explores the emotional dimensions of design. The organic forms of an omnipresent nature are embodied in the creations of cabinetmaker Maxime Goléo.

programme.desc: Leather is his preferred means of expression, we meet flamboyant designer Jean-Claude Jitrois. Nylon revolutionised the textile industry: but where did its name come from? programme.title: I Witness Roswell Alien Legacy
programme.desc: When the U.S. Army base in Roswell, NM closed in 1967 it looked like this little town might dry up and blow away. The town was slowly rebuilding its economy when it stumbled on an unexpected boon. Roswell found the Alien. A little known local legend had kicked around for years. It said that, in 1947. something crashed in the desert just north of town and the military covered up the incident. Now, thanks to the legend, Roswell is on the cover of Time Magazine and the pheonix-like rise from the ashes is complete. As tens of thousands of tourists and their fat wallets land in Roswell, we join the search for the truth.

programme.desc: Three friends who all work together at a local video store stumble upon a mysterious device labeled “DPT” which has a mysterious function: predicting the absolute worst possible outcome of any moment or decision. programme.title: Who is She
programme.desc: Megan is a beautiful woman in search of love and acceptance but masks a tormented soul. Beneath the surface lies a volatile woman with multiple personalities and a dangerous capacity for violence.

programme.title: Judge Knott
programme.desc: A father’s horrible mistake causes a lifetime of pain for his children. His son tries his best to live a normal life, but his childhood trauma follows him into his marriage. He must face his trauma head on to break this generational curse.

programme.title: Cougar
programme.desc: Donna and her young college son Brandon live in a nice suburban area of Atlanta, until a new and mysterious older woman moves in next door. Donna invites her over to dinner where she and Brandon connect, and build a connection that is deadly and manipulative. A mother must save her son before it’s too late.

programme.title: The Lies We Tell but the Secrets We Keep: The Last Lie
programme.desc: Obstacles derail Roni and Bri's attempt at a fresh start, but what is done in the dark always come to light.

programme.title: The Frozen Hearts: A Love Story
programme.desc: A couple attempt to find their way back to each other after a traumatic loss. Bombarded with advice and opinions from their friends and family about their relationship, will they work it out? Or fall out of love?

programme.title: She's Watching
programme.desc: Richard and Zoey have recently moved into their dream home, only to find themselves being watched by an obsessed neighbor. Watching them every night isn't enough to satisfy her urges, so she makes an offer they can't refuse.

programme.title: Hoodie Girls Gang
programme.desc: Kayla's boyfriend Jamal is jailed and needs $10,000 bail. Desperate, Kayla and her friends plan an armed robbery. However, the heist goes wrong, and the police are on their trail. To make matters worse, Jamal's boss, Sean, demands payment for the drugs Jamal was transporting. Kayla must now free Jamal and escape town before both the police and Sean catch up to her.

programme.title: Deeper
programme.desc: The story of Chasity, King, and Gotti is a tale of love, betrayal, and power. Gotti returns with a vengeance, seeking to reclaim his Dallas Kingpin status and Chasity's love. Despite their challenges, Chasity and King remain determined. As they plan their future, Gotti's secrets and power grab threaten their love. Will they triumph over his schemes or will he steal her heart? Follow their journey in the dangerous world of the hustle.

programme.title: Through Sickness and Hell
programme.desc: When a police officer is trapped in a toxic marriage, he must find the strength to break free from his abusive wife, risking his career, reputation, but also his life as he battles the damaging stigma surrounding domestic violence against men.

programme.title: The Miracle of Tonya Pinkins
programme.desc: A musical biographical documentary about the life, times and career of Tony Award winner and Broadway performing star Tonya Pinkins (Jelly’s Last Jam, Play On, Caroline or Change) the movie chronicles her beginning as a professional child actress in Chicago to an award winning Broadway star, along with the stories and songs that made her one of America’s top performing artists.

programme.title: Till Lies Do Us Part
programme.desc: Amina and Alex announce their engagement to their family and friends after only dating for six months, and are having a destination wedding at that. As the romantic and loving getaway goes along, betrayals and hidden truths come to the surface causing chaos and drama.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: Kill For You
programme.desc: Suga, a devoted mother, finds herself opening up to love again when she begins a relationship with Danny, a man who seems genuine and caring. But their connection is quickly tested when she is introduced to Danny’s father, Rusty—a man whose deeply rooted racism creates an undercurrent of tension that can’t be ignored. As Suga tries to navigate the relationship while protecting her son, she begins to sense that something isn’t right beneath the surface.

programme.title: The Lyric
programme.desc: An aspiring singer discovers the lyrics in a song written for her could lead her to the killer of the writer who wrote it.

programme.title: Sweet Mahogany 3: The Final Entanglement
programme.desc: The lives of Mahogany Andrews and those around her are drastically changed after devastating news changes relationships and reveals dark secrets from the past that will have a major impact on everyone’s future.

programme.title: Double Blended
programme.desc: Two couples, once married to each other’s ex-spouses, form a double-blended family. Their seemingly harmonious coexistence is threatened when a past secret resurfaces, forcing them to confront their complicated relationships.

programme.title: Played in My Face
programme.desc: Tonya’s life is almost picture perfect, and a wedding on the horizon to the man of her dreams, Victor. One night she receives an anonymous email exposing Victor at a hotel on the same night he claimed to be away on business. Her quiet suspicion spirals into obsession as she discovers that Victor’s betrayal runs deeper than she ever imagined.

programme.title: Curse of a Father
programme.desc: A father’s horrible mistake causes a lifetime of pain for his children. His son tries his best to live a normal life, but his childhood trauma follows him into his marriage. He must face his trauma head on to break this generational curse.

programme.title: Trapped in the Game: Fool Me Once
programme.desc: When FBI agent Dallas Bush is assigned to take down a powerful businessman turned drug lord, he realizes the payout could cover his dying mother’s medical expenses. Dallas must navigate a dangerous web of deception, crime, and moral compromise, where every choice comes with a price.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: Guilty Victim
programme.desc: A dangerous investor with a violent past is pulled back into chaos when a home security scheme spirals out of control, forcing him to confront old wounds, betrayal, and a brutal fight to protect what little he has left.

programme.title: What I'd Do For Love
programme.desc: Greer Patterson’s happy marriage falls apart when she discovers her husband’s infidelity. After exacting bitter revenge, she’s back on the market looking for love, and anyone standing in her way will see just how far she’ll go.

programme.title: The Groomsman
programme.desc: A co-ed bachelor and bachelorette getaway at a secluded Airbnb spirals into a night of fear and suspicion when Savanna’s former love unexpectedly arrives as a groomsman in her upcoming wedding to Bryce. As tensions rise and unsettling events begin to unfold, it becomes clear that someone is manipulating the group from the shadows.

programme.title: The Offer
programme.desc: When Devin and Imani—an estranged couple drowning under financial pressure—receive an unmarked briefcase containing a life-changing sum of money, they find themselves faced with an impossible decision. As tensions rise, secrets unravel, and old wounds reopen, the couple begins to fracture under the moral and emotional weight of the offer.

programme.title: Blind Tiez
programme.desc: Naire is on the up and up as he’s recently promoted to be the youngest detective in the police department. When one of his cases goes completely wrong, he stands accused of murder, and must race to clear his name.

programme.title: The New Girl
programme.desc: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica’s seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister. She then launches her own investigation and unearths a twisted web of lies, abuse, and even political conspiracy. Malorie must confront dangerous secrets that not only threaten her sister’s life but her own.
